author: Howsie
body:
When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network please include the following: 
  • Your minecraft username 
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • Why you should be unbanned
SEND ALL APPEALS TO SUPPORT@AVICUS.NET AND DO NOT POST YOUR APPEAL ON THE FORUMS.
